_comment: Stage 1 (video -> steps) benchmark dataset, organised by UI VARIATION rather than by product.
Ground truth here is authored from the test-harness scenario catalog (test-harness/public/index.html);
each case points at a deterministic harness page served at http://localhost:4599.
TO RUN: start the harness (cd test-harness && npm start) so pages are live, then record one short
screen-recording per case performing the described task and REPLACE the placeholder `videoPath`.
Login fixtures (where a page needs them): test.user@demo.local / Demo!Pass123.
`uiVariety` is the axis we report on: field:*, nav:*, paging:*, discovery:*, tricky:*, look:*, language:*.
`mode` = PLACEHOLDER means credentials must be tokenised in the output (secret-leak hard gate applies);
LITERAL means the on-screen demo values are expected verbatim.
